title: Three Autumns and One Short Corner
subtitle: 生活用品 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生活用品（人与自我·生活与学习·个人生活与物品）
meta: 主题语境：生活用品（人与自我·生活与学习·个人生活与物品）　|　核心词汇：handkerchief　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 handkerchief 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the mother ① folded a handkerchief that no daughter in the house would have described, and she said the folding was the whole of the autumn. The ② handkerchief, meaning the cloth itself and not the pocket, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a handkerchief, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ handkerchief in that house had the same short corner beside it, and the ④ handkerchief at the far drawer, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A handkerchief, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the mother said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the handkerchief was the whole of the matter, meaning the keepsake and not the cloth. The ⑥ handkerchief, meaning the keepsake and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; handkerchief, he said, is either something you fold or the only word that means both a cloth and a keepsake. He said the keepsake is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ handkerchief had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short corner. The ⑧ handkerchief of the whole thing, the mother wrote in November, was one house and three autumns of describing; handkerchief, she said, is either the one at the far drawer or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ handkerchief I remember is the one described in the note, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ handkerchief, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being described; every handkerchief, she said, is a keepsake that has agreed to look like a cloth. She said the keepsake was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手帕（指房子里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 手帕（指那块布本身，与口袋相对）
C. 固定搭配：fold a handkerchief 折一块手帕
D. n. 手帕（指留给孩子们学着折的那一块）
E. n. 手绢（抽象总称，指一座房子的手帕之事）
F. n. 手帕（指便条里写到、被记下的那一块）
G. n. 方巾；围巾（指一件事里人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 头巾（抽象总称，指人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: folded a handkerchief that no daughter in the house would have described
The handkerchief, meaning the cloth itself and not the pocket
the handkerchief at the far drawer
the handkerchief was the whole of the matter

The handkerchief of the whole thing
A handkerchief, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: fold a handkerchief 意为“折一块手帕”，1966 年那位母亲折了房子里没有一位女儿肯描述的一块手帕。
handkerchief 意为“手帕”，指那块布本身而不是口袋，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
handkerchief 意为“手帕”，指房子里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一个矮矮的角。
handkerchief 意为“手帕”，指最远那个抽屉里留给孩子们学着折的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
handkerchief 意为“方巾、围巾”，指一件事里人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块方巾就是那件事的全部。
handkerchief 意为“头巾”，指人人都戴却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块手帕，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
handkerchief 意为“手帕”，指便条里写到、被记下的那一块，到 1971 年这一块成了便条里的一行。
handkerchief 意为“手绢”，母亲十一月写道，整件事的手帕之事是一座房子和三个秋天的描述。
handkerchief 意为“手帕”，我记得的是便条里描述过的那一块，1973 年送人了，至今仍被说成房子里最安静的一块。
handkerchief 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，手帕是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的布。
